desc: Implement prefix sums `S[i]` and `C[i]` for nums and cost.
For each `i` from 1 to n, for each `j` from 0 to i-1, compute the subarray cost.
The group index for the last subarray is `cnt[j] + 1`.
`dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[j] + subarray_cost)`, and set `cnt[i] = cnt[j] + 1` for the achieving min.
Test edge cases (e.g., single element array, all elements in one group).
Ensure no integer overflow issues (Python handles big integers natively).
